name: How long does a bathroom accessibility modification usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom accessibility modification usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on how much work is involved and whether plumbing, electrical, or structural changes are needed. A smaller safety update can move faster than a full accessibility conversion, and permitting or custom products can add time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small safety upgrades can be quick, but a full accessibility remodel takes longer because plumbing, layout, and permit requirements can add time.
